checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1 severity contradicts the review's own Tasks section: tasks.md:81 ticks 6.2 `[x]`, but the review marks it ❌ and says its scratch check 'exits 1'. The acceptance criteria reserve CRITICAL for 'a ticked-but-undone task', yet R1 is a WARNING, the Summary shows 0 CRITICAL and the Verdict says 'Nothing blocks at CRITICAL'. Either judge 6.2 done in substance (✅ with a note, R1 stays WARNING) or raise R1 to CRITICAL and change the Verdict.

R1's Fix says 'keep the patch and the README as they are', but handoff/README.md:9-15 breaks .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md:69-77, which requires the fields 'in this order': **Serves:**, **Files:**, **Apply:**, **Verify:**, **Why manual:** and **Automated part:** 'copied from `tasks.md`'. The H1 section has no **Files:** line and uses the order Apply, Patch, Changes, Serves, Why manual, Automated part, Verify. This README section is part of task 6.2, so the fix should also add **Files:** and reorder the fields.
